items.title: Leon Rene Interview, 1979-05-07
items.q: when I made success in my record company, exclusive records had arrived. And we had Joe Liggins and his Honey Drippers, the number one all over the country

ctx.x: Yeah. Anyway, we were looking at that picture of Buddy Petit. I sure would like to know more about Buddy Petit and what he played and what he sounded like.

Well, I don't know. First time that Buddy Petit came to Covington, I remember that very well. Because it probably was a Saturday night dance he had to play for. And so he did, he had to play this for, it was a white dance that was down in the Pavilion, that I recall, down by the river, Bofilaya River. And he got off the train and seated this customer at that time, naturally, for the band to play something at the station. You know, and we, so that everybody in town could know. It's just like broadcasting that I'm…
We really got ahead. But because I should ask you when you were born and where and about your family and all that stuff.
